scenes.text: PrioriHealth. Emergency triage support, with a nurse in the loop.
Emergency departments have to decide, fast, who needs care first. Often with a full waiting room.
When a patient arrives, the triage nurse writes a short note: symptoms, history, and vital signs.
Ten AI reviewers, each with a different reasoning style, read the note and assess the patient independently.
If they disagree, they discuss. They revise only for a clinical reason, until at least nine of ten agree.
If they can't agree, or an urgent warning is overruled, the case goes straight to a nurse to decide.
The waiting room is ordered by acuity and time waited, so the patients most overdue for care are seen first.
It all runs privately on IBM LinuxONE. PrioriHealth: decision support that keeps clinicians in charge.
